def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # find 2-line
    div=[r for r in range(h) if all(x==2 for x in g[r])]
    if not div: return g
    d=div[0]
    # find non-background shape (values not in {0,2}) - background of test is 1 though; demo bg 0
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in g for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[v for v in cnt if v not in (bg,2,8)]
    shape=others[0]
    cells=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==shape]
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    r0,r1=min(rs),max(rs); c0,c1=min(cs),max(cs)
    sub=[[g[r][c] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    out=[[bg]*w for _ in range(h)]
    for r in range(h):
        if all(x==2 for x in g[r]): out[r]=[2]*w
    nr=d+1
    for i,row in enumerate(sub):
        for j,v in enumerate(row):
            if v!=bg: out[nr+i][c0+j]=v
    for c in range(w): out[nr+len(sub)][c]=8
    return out
